notes: The supplied for introducing the infinitive's expressed subject is kept with κἀμέ, the word it marks; putting it on the infinitive under rule 74 remains defensible.
s005 τοῦ is the nominalizing article of an articular infinitive that no preposition governs, so it is unrepresented and to is rule 7's helper on πορεύεσθαι (rule 61).
